capabilities: : Run installed views in side panels
disambiguation: Not a standard note-taking interface; it is a dedicated floating popout window for quick capture.
extras: Desktop only; not available on Obsidian Mobile.
intentEvidence: Floating Notes brings that frictionless capture workflow into Obsidian.
motivation: To combine an in-app command, an obsidian:// URI handler, and a loopback HTTP endpoint to allow users to trigger a floating editor from anywhere.
problem: Obsidian lacks a simple, system-wide mechanism for instant, distraction-free note capture using a global hotkey.

relations.evidence: Pair one of those triggers with the system-wide launcher of your choice.

summary: A lightweight plugin that provides a floating popout window for instant, distraction-free note capture, inspired by Raycast Notes.
